subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

When pigs fly

options.text: Something that will never last long

solution: The correct answer is** Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"When pigs fly"** means something **that will never happen.** (ऐसी बात जो कभी नहीं होगी) • **Example: **He'll clean his room **when pigs fly.** • **"Never" **refers to something that will not happen at any time or under any circumstances. (कभी नहीं) • **Example: **I will** never **forget your kindness. Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'When pigs fly' **is **'Something that will never happen'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Something that will never last long** (ऐसी बात जो कभी ज्यादा समय तक नहीं चलेगी) • **Example:** Their relationship is **something that will never last long.** • **Option 2: Something that will never deviate** (ऐसी बात जो कभी विचलित नहीं होगी) • **Example: **Her dedication is **something that will never deviate.** • **Option 3: Something that will get completed** (ऐसी बात जो पूरी हो जाएगी) • **Example:** The project is something **that will get completed **by the end of this month. 3cb:Te67, The correct answer is **Option 1)**
